BiblicalUsage: A little is all Eliphaz heard: a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little thereof. Job answers that these are but parts of God's ways, and how little a portion is heard of Him. Two verses, both about hearing almost nothing of a God too great to hear fully.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the little portion is the honest confession of every theologian, for we hear a whisper of His ways, and I hold that the whisper is enough to trust Him with the thunder.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
